name: Sin
role: Guardian of Hell's gate; Satan's daughter and, by him, mother of Death
description: Category D, thin biblical seed, heavy classical borrowing. Sprang fully formed from Satan's head during the rebellion in Heaven -- an explicit echo of Athena springing armed from the head of Zeus. Satan then begets Death on her by incestuous rape; Death in turn rapes his own mother, producing the hounds that gnaw at her womb. The only scriptural anchor is James 1:15 ('sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death') -- one metaphorical sentence expanded into a full genealogical horror-allegory. Also modeled directly on Spenser's monster Error (The Faerie Queene, Book I). See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §III.
narrative_function: Guards Hell's gate with Death; the mechanism by which Satan can physically leave Hell -- she alone holds the key.
